user.title: Choose your Huawei Scale 3
user.description: The scale only shows up while someone is standing on it. Step on it now and reopen this dialog if it is not listed, or type its Bluetooth address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up Huawei Scale 3
bluetooth_confirm.description: Found {name} ({address}). Next you will enter its authentication key and your profile.

secrets.title: Authentication key
secrets.description: The scale authenticates and encrypts its data with three 16-byte keys (CAK, C1 and C2) that this integration does not supply. Enter them concatenated in that order as 96 hexadecimal characters (CAK, then C1, then C2); see the README. This is kept only in this config entry, never written to the integration's files.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: The scale needs your sex, age and height before it can measure, and the integration uses them to calculate body composition. The starting weight is only used until the first measurement.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the authentication key
reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected the authentication several times in a row. Check the key and enter it again.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_key: Enter exactly 96 hexadecimal characters (CAK, C1 and C2 concatenated).
error.name_exists: A profile with this name already exists.
error.invalid_birth_date: Enter a valid date of birth in the past.

abort.already_configured: This scale is already set up.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a Huawei Scale 3.

settings.title: Behaviour
settings.description: History import fires an event for measurements stored on the scale that were taken while Home Assistant could not hear it. The cool-down stops the scale being re-read straight after a weigh-in.
